import sys

def main():
    a = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    b = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    c = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    d = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    op1 = (a + b) * c
    op2 = (b - d) // a
    op3 = a * d + c
    op4 = (a + b + c + d) // 2
    
    print(f"Result of operation 1: {op1}")
    print(f"Result of operation 2: {op2}")
    print(f"Result of operation 3: {op3}")
    print(f"Result of operation 4: {op4}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
